hypotheses_falsified.claim: Typedef names collected from quoted local headers are enough to recognise C pointer declarators
hypotheses_falsified.evidence: pool.c 'atomic_uint *gen' (typedef from <stdatomic.h>) yielded a '*'->'/' build-error mutant. Verified: no mutant on pool.c:56; every remaining '*' mutant in pool.c, platform_win.c and quant.c inspected is a real product.
